title: GCP Load Balancing: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Imagine a food truck festival with a long queue. You'd send people to the shortest line. That's what a load balancer does.

scenes.heading: The food truck festival
scenes.narration: Load balancers come at two layers. Layer four balancers decide using addresses and ports. Layer seven balancers look at the content of the request. Both spread traffic across several backends. A C D N caches content near the visitor.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. Only layer seven reads the content. It only distributes traffic. They do different jobs.

items.wrong: CDN is the same as a balancer

scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva GCP load balancing lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. Layer four uses addresses and ports. Layer seven reads the request. A C D N caches near users. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva GCP load balancing lab.
